node.title: The full-rank component-star large owner is record-intrinsic
node.closure: support-overlap uniqueness from the RS root bound
node.statement: Uniformly over every residual shortening, a record has at most one polynomial-pair owner whose within-support pair core has deficiency at most 22320. Indeed, two such cores would intersect in at least K'+22832 coordinates, while two distinct RS pairs can agree in both components on at most K'-1 coordinates. Consequently every full-rank 98-percent component-star output has a unique large owner independent of the chosen ten-subset. This is a recordwise owner key, not an aggregate chronology payment.
